missions.title: The misplaced delivery
missions.first_lead: Corvin handled the delivery slip. Ask him to check the destination label.
missions.summary: Ada's labelled vegetable crate reached the wrong destination. Find out where it went and bring it back before the fair.

steps.text: Ask Corvin about Ada's delivery labels.
steps.fact: Confirmed: Ada's actual vegetable crate is currently beside the western market. The crate was delivered there because its destination label was wrong. It has not reached Ada. Alden is not the delivery destination, and theft has not been proved. Tell the visiting player to recover the labelled crate at the western market.
steps.journal_note: The destination label sent Ada’s vegetable crate to the western market. It is waiting beside the stalls.

steps.text: Recover Ada's labelled crate beside the western market.
Bring the recovered crate back to Ada.
steps.fact: The visitor is returning your labelled crate of greens. The agreed reward is twelve coins from the town's delivery fund. Once they hand it over, you can sell those vegetables at your stall again. Speak as Ada about the delivery and your thanks.
steps.journal_note: The recovered crate is back with Ada. The delivery fund paid twelve coins, and her stall has been restocked.

missions.title: A wagon before the fair
missions.first_lead: Bram is making the replacement metal fittings. Ask whether they are ready.
missions.summary: Oren can repair a supply wagon if Bram's replacement fittings arrive. Help finish the work so deliveries can continue.

steps.text: Ask Bram about Oren's replacement wagon fittings.
steps.fact: You finished Oren's wagon fittings and left the labelled bundle beside the eastern supply store at (42,-43). Tell the visitor where to collect it. No payment is needed.
steps.journal_note: Bram finished the fittings and left the labelled bundle beside the eastern supply store.

steps.text: Collect the labelled fittings beside the eastern supply store.
Fit the parts at the carpenter's workbench. Hold E nearby for four seconds.
Tell Oren the fittings are ready and hand them over.
steps.fact: The visitor fitted the real wagon parts at your workbench. You can complete the supply wagon in the workyard and use it for deliveries. The agreed repair reward is eighteen coins from the town's repair fund.
steps.journal_note: Oren received the finished fittings. His supply wagon can return to work.

missions.title: The overdue surveyor
missions.first_lead: Rowan served Ansel breakfast before the trip. Ask Rowan where he was going.
missions.summary: Ansel went to survey the western gatehouse and missed a check-in. Follow the accounts of the people who saw him and make sure he is safe.

steps.text: Ask Rowan when Ansel last visited the tavern.
steps.fact: Ansel had breakfast here, then went to compare old masonry at the western gatehouse. Nils lent him a survey sketch. You saw no sign of trouble. Share these facts if asked.
steps.journal_note: Rowan saw Ansel leave breakfast to survey the western gatehouse. Nils lent him a sketch.

steps.text: Ask Nils which part of the western gatehouse Ansel planned to inspect.
steps.fact: Ansel planned to work beside the western gatehouse entrance. He often forgets the time when sketching, but promised Greta a check-in. Tell the visitor where to look.
steps.journal_note: Nils marked the entrance to the western gatehouse. Ansel planned to compare the masonry there.

steps.text: Find Ansel beside the western gatehouse and speak with him.
steps.fact: You are safe, tired from surveying and embarrassed that you missed Greta's check-in. Ask the visitor to let Greta know you are well; you will remain here to finish recording the masonry.
steps.journal_note: Ansel is safe at the gatehouse. He lost track of time while sketching and needs Greta to receive his check-in.

steps.text: Let Greta know Ansel is safe at the western gatehouse.
steps.fact: The visitor personally found Ansel alive and safe beside the western gatehouse. They are bringing his check-in, not rescuing him from an invented attack. Thank them for checking.
steps.journal_note: Greta has received Ansel’s check-in. He is safe and finishing his survey beside the western gatehouse.

missions.title: A dry store for the castle
missions.summary: Sven needs a sound supply crate to replace damaged storage at the castle provisions yard.
missions.first_lead: Gareth inspected the damaged store. Check his report, then make a supply crate at the workbench.
missions.result_news: Sven’s castle provisions yard has a sound new storage crate.

steps.text: Check Gareth’s report on the castle store.
steps.journal_note: The provisions yard needs one sound supply crate. Craft one at the repair workbench using four timber and one metal fitting.
steps.fact: The crate at the castle provisions yard is damaged. Sven requested one new supply crate.

steps.text: Bring a crafted supply crate to Sven.
steps.journal_note: Sven has received the new crate. The repaired storage is in use beside the castle provisions yard.
steps.fact: The visitor must physically hand over a crafted supply crate before the store is repaired.

missions.title: Tools for the castle workshop
missions.summary: With the store repaired, Sven can reopen a work corner if Bram’s worn tools are refurbished.
missions.first_lead: Ask Bram which tools can be restored.
missions.result_news: The castle workshop has a refurbished set of tools.

steps.journal_note: Refurbish a tool set at the repair bench using two timber and two metal fittings, then bring it to Sven.
steps.fact: Sven needs one repaired tool set, made at the repair bench.

steps.text: Deliver the refurbished tools to Sven.
steps.journal_note: The castle workshop now has its refurbished tools and can resume repair work.
steps.fact: A repaired tool set is needed for the castle workshop.

missions.title: A place for the new crew
missions.summary: Alec’s crew needs a sturdy table for sorting deliveries in the industrial yard.
missions.first_lead: Finn can explain the joinery requirements.
missions.result_news: Alec’s industrial crew has a new sorting table in the yard.

steps.text: Check Finn’s requirements for a sorting table.
steps.journal_note: The crew needs one crafted table. Reach Carpentry level one, then use six timber and two metal fittings at the repair bench.
steps.fact: The new industrial crew needs one table for sorting deliveries.

steps.text: Deliver the crafted table to Alec.
steps.journal_note: Alec has received the table. The industrial crew’s sorting area is now furnished.
steps.fact: A crafted table must be delivered before the sorting area is furnished.
